comment: Suspected-but-undocumented Miro API paths, probed live by live-probe.py alongside the weekly spec diff. known_status is the last verified answer; any deviation is the file-an-issue signal. Rationale: the spec baseline (miroapp/api-clients) omits endpoints Miro actually ships — comments answered a plain PAT for weeks while absent from the spec (bead 7rh). Placeholders: {board_id}, {team_id}, {table_id} are resolved by the probe script at run time.

probes.name: board sections (list)
probes.signal: Route EXISTS in the v2 gateway (400 Validation failure, not 404 No endpoint) but is feature-gated or needs a param we did not guess. A flip to 200 means sections reached public REST.

probes.name: board prototypes (list)
probes.signal: Same as sections: the route exists but is not usable as probed. A flip to 200 means prototypes reached public REST.

probes.name: spaces (v2)
probes.signal: Hosted-connector-only today (404 No endpoint). Any change means spaces are reaching public REST.

probes.name: spaces (v2-experimental)
probes.signal: Hosted-connector-only today. Any change means spaces are reaching the experimental REST surface.

probes.name: team spaces
probes.signal: Hosted-connector-only today. Any change means team-scoped spaces are reaching public REST.

probes.name: board layout
probes.signal: The official connector's layout DSL has no public REST twin. Any change means layout endpoints are landing.

probes.name: data table rows
probes.signal: Table metadata is public (miro_list_tables/miro_get_table) but row access is hosted-only. Any change unlocks row CRUD tools.

probes.name: image resource fetch
probes.signal: Every image item carries data.imageUrl pointing at resource id 0, and fetching it is a 400 'Has illegal integer number value'. A working fetch on any image item means the miro-mcp-apps board-svg view can embed real image bits in place of placeholder glyphs.
probes.source: bead u9a NOTES, board-svg fidelity round (miro-mcp-apps PR #6), 15-08-2026
